name.ja: 30MF アイテムショップ1 (ナイトオプション)

description.ja: 自分だけのファンタジージョブを創り出すことが出来る新プラモデルシリーズ『30 MINUTES FANTASY』より、「30MF アイテムショップ1 (ナイトオプション)」が登場！
description.en: "30MF Item Shop 1 (Night Option)" is now available from the new plastic model series " 30 MINUTES FANTASY" where you can create your own fantasy job!

description.ja: • “アーマークロス”［装甲換装］の幅を広げる武装やアイテムが詰まったセット。
description.en: • A set packed with weapons and items that expand the range of “Armor Cloth” [Armor Replacement].

description.ja: • フェイスや肩、胸アーマーのパーツは2種類のデザインのものが付属。
description.en: • Two different designs of face, shoulder, and chest armor parts are included.

description.ja: • ナイトの装備より軽量タイプのシールドが付属。
description.en: • Comes with Seal, which is lighter than the knight's equipment.

description.ja: • 「宝箱」と「ポーション」はグレーとクリアブルーの2種類が付属。「宝箱」は蓋を開閉可能。
description.en: • Two types of "treasure box " and " potion " are included: gray and clear blue. The " treasure box" has a lid that can be opened and closed.

description.ja: • 30MFアイテムと別売りの30MSアイテムとのミキシングに便利な「30MS用ジョイントパーツ」が付属。
description.en: • "Joint parts for 30MS" are included, which is convenient for mixing 30MF items and 30MS items (sold separately).
